h1: Custom Folding Blankets for Branded Promotions
metaDescription: Order custom folding blankets with your logo. Perfect for giveaways and corporate gifts. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Folding blankets combine portability with comfort, making them ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, and employee gifts. Unlike traditional throws, these blankets fold compactly into a built-in carrying case or strap, so recipients can easily pack them for picnics, concerts, or travel. Options like the Carry-It™ Picnic Throw or Roll-Up Picnic Blanket offer practical branding space on the outer shell or closure. Choose from fleece, sherpa, or plaid materials to match your company colors. Custom screen printing or embroidery ensures your logo stays visible whether the blanket is folded or unfurled.
heroAltText: Custom folding blankets with logo, including a plaid picnic blanket folded with strap, ideal for corporate giveaways and outdoor events.
